long_biography.plain_text:
Property investor Joel Meisel valued established management relationships when selecting hotel partners. For the Radisson Hotel Cross Keys acquisition in Baltimore, his investment business returned to Interstate Hotels & Resorts, which had managed earlier assets. He highlighted the firm's scale, management record and experience in repositioning properties. Interstate took a minority equity interest and retained the operating contract.

Beyond business, Meisel and Debi Meisel joined the Best Buddies Israel Founders Committee. The group recruited supporters and sought funding for a new programme pairing students with people with intellectual disabilities. Its fundraising plan supported a leadership fund over three years.
